sql: INSERT INTO scheduled_flights (asset_id, cfi_id, student_id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, duration_hours, notes, status, created_by) SELECT (SELECT id FROM assets WHERE is_flight_asset = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM cfis WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), s.id, date('now','+5 day'), '10:00', 1.5, 'Pattern work', 'scheduled', 'Front Desk' FROM students s WHERE s.user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'flight_student' LIMIT 1)
